STEP 1 - Scene: A breakfast tray with a coffee mug, a muffin, a small yogurt pot, two slices of multigrain toast, two fried eggs and sliced avocado on a paper plate. Photographed from the front at a slight elevated angle, roughly eye level with the tray.

STEP 2 - Ruler: The paper plate is about 20 cm in diameter (side-plate size). Area = 3.14 x 10^2 = 314 cm^2. The tray is roughly 40 cm wide, consistent with this scale.

STEP 3 - Items (on the plate and tray): fried eggs (2), avocado slices, two slices of multigrain bread, muffin, yogurt pot, coffee with milk. Only the plate contents are weighed as the meal; the muffin, yogurt and drink are included as separate items.

STEP 4 - Area (of the 314 cm^2 plate):
- Fried eggs (2 together): ~30% = 94 cm^2, height ~1.5 cm
- Avocado slices: ~10% = 31 cm^2, height ~1 cm
- Toast slices (2 overlapping, sitting partly off the plate): ~25% of plate area = 79 cm^2 on-plate, height ~2 cm (stacked)

STEP 5 - Volume:
- Eggs: 94 x 1.5 = 141 ml
- Avocado: 31 x 1.0 = 31 ml
- Toast: 2 slices, each ~ 12 x 11 x 1.5 cm ≈ 200 ml bread total (both slices, counted as a stack, ~2 slices x 1.5 cm thick)
- Muffin: a standard muffin ~ 7 cm diameter, 5 cm tall, roughly 120 ml
- Yogurt pot: ~125 g pot, treat as 125 ml
- Coffee: mug ~ 300 ml, roughly 250 ml of liquid (milky coffee)

STEP 6 - Grams:
- Eggs: 141 x 0.9 ≈ 127 g (two fried eggs, consistent with ~50 g each)
- Avocado: 31 x 0.6 ≈ 19 g (cut fruit; sliced pieces, roughly 1/4 to 1/3 of a fruit)
- Toast: two slices, ~30 g each ≈ 60 g (bread slice ~0.3 g/ml on the envelope basis, so the sized volume gives ~60 g)
- Muffin: ~ 120 ml x 0.4 (baked, airy) ≈ 60 g; a typical muffin is ~60–70 g
- Yogurt: 125 g
- Coffee with milk: 250 g (liquid)

STEP 7 - Energy (kcal per 100 g, as plated):
- Fried egg: 196 kcal/100g (fried in oil, adds a little)
- Avocado: 160 kcal/100g
- Multigrain bread: 250 kcal/100g
- Muffin (fruit/bran type): 370 kcal/100g
- Yogurt (fruit, low-fat): 90 kcal/100g
- Coffee with milk: 15 kcal/100g

Energies: eggs 127 g → 249 kcal; avocado 19 g → 30 kcal; toast 60 g → 150 kcal; muffin 60 g → 222 kcal; yogurt 125 g → 113 kcal; coffee 250 g → 38 kcal.

STEP 8 - Sanity check: Total solid food ≈ 364 g plus 250 g drink, about 614 g and roughly 800 kcal. Plausible for a full breakfast with two eggs, two toast slices, muffin and yogurt. Eggs and toast dominate the plated weight as expected.

Estimated total: about 614 g (including coffee), about 800 kcal.
